'''Braad''' was a continent of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bakura/Legends|Bakura]]. It was the location of the [[Kishh district]], which was inhabited largely by members of the [[Kurtzen]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Braad also had many [[namana]] plantations.
